skills.trigger: When evaluating serial chest radiographs to assess interval change in a mediastinal mass or superior mediastinal width.
steps: Compare the transverse width of the superior mediastinum relative to the thoracic diameter and tracheal position on the baseline image versus the follow-up image.
Inspect the lung bases for new opacities, consolidation, or pleural effusion that were not present previously.

Distinguish rapid tumor recurrence (marked widening of mediastinum + new parenchymal/pleural disease) from stable post-surgical changes (consistent width, no new infiltrates) or hematoma (stable or slowly evolving opacity without aggressive growth patterns).
